title: Hyprune object manifest 0.10 (DRAFT until world format 0.10): adds the mover trait, the RFC-0013 machine trait and the slot additions

bounds.description: Rest-pose AABB in asset space (metres, +Y up, front +Z).

collidable.description: The 0.8 static collision proxy: a mesh node, not animated, not in an animated subtree.

movable.description: Offered for user placement. Defaults: surfaces ["floor"], upright true for floor and ceiling, scale [1, 1].

walk.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

idle.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

additionalProperties.description: Values the import step measured; speed must match the clip's extras.speed within 2%.

character.description: RFC-0010 character: clips with measured values (walk and idle required), height and radius in metres.

mover.description: Rides track paths; item: true makes it a pooled item (at most 2,000 triangles, 1 MiB).

machine.description: RFC-0013 machine (draft): typed inputs, drives from inputs to slot targets, value-driven positions and source recipes.

mount.description: Reserved (RFC-0011 P4): a prop that holds a window. Rejected in object format 0.10.

interactive.description: Reserved (RFC-0011 P4): use actions on ordinary objects. Rejected in object format 0.10.

traits.description: Trait name to trait data. Unknown or reserved names reject the object.

rate.description: Copies per second the shown count moves toward the target; 0 or absent: at once.

items.description: A subtree scaled (fill) or moved (slide) by level:<id>, 0-1. axis: asset-space unit vector, default [0, 1, 0]; surface: fill only; settle default ease.

animation.description: A world 0.8 declarative node animation (spin, orbit or bob).

interaction.description: Asset-level character interaction: only say and panel, which reference nothing in a world.

seatAnchor.description: Where the sitter's root stands at the start of sit (asset space), facing yaw degrees about +Y from +Z. perch, lean and ground uses are reserved.

average.description: Running average modifier: the time-weighted mean of the value over the last windowS seconds (default 60) of fresh data; the mapping's form applies to it. override (drives only): another non-event input whose value, while present, replaces the average.

mapping.description: RFC-0013 mapping language: direct ({}), cases, thresholds, scale, becomes, counter or format; average modifies the value forms (not becomes or counter).

input.description: A typed machine input (RFC-0013). repeat makes indexed inputs id.1 ... id.N.
